verdict.rationale: x402 Bazaar is a public, keyless discovery API listing payment-gated services. A runtime probe confirmed it returns machine-readable listings with USDC prices, asset contracts, network, scheme and timeout. The 402 payment-required response also quotes the price for each request. However, it covers pay-per-request API resources rather than general products, and has no documented availability, product-variant or checkout-link fields. Missing for 10: explicit availability/stock data, product variants, checkout links, coverage of non-API products and services.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read machine-readable offer data — price, availability, variants, checkout links — for any listed product or service

citations.quote: The x402 Bazaar is a catalog of payment-gated services discovered by the CDP Facilitator.
returned real payable-service listings (USDC amounts, asset contracts, network eip155:8453/Base, scheme exact, maxTimeoutSeconds) with no CDP API key
